name: Village Square
description: The open heart of the village. The cafe fronts the square. The rear alley entrance is visible from the bench.

name: Rear Alley
description: The narrow service alley behind the cafe and bookshop. Bins, crates, a linen delivery bay. The alley is where Clara is found. A small fire was set near the bins — it scorched the crate stack and a section of wall before dying out.

name: Hobbs Cafe
description: The village cafe. Clara's workplace. The rear door opens onto the alley.

name: Flat above Hobbs Cafe
description: Clara's flat above the cafe. Found to contain documents about the property title.

name: Owen Price's House & Yard
description: Owen's house and builder's yard. His supposed alibi location.

name: Village Clinic
description: Nadia's workplace. She crosses between the square and clinic at 07:00.

name: Reed & Bell Bookshop
description: The bookshop, adjacent to the rear alley.

name: Fountain
description: The stone fountain in the square.
